title: Sela 087 Sound-Optimized Cajon - Corrugated Cardboard
desc:
Sela 087 Sound-Optimized Cajon - Corrugated Cardboard Overview : The Sela Carton Cajon is an affordable and great sounding alternative to a wooden cajon. Built up and played the audience will be astonished: “Can a cardboard sound like that?” With its powerful bass and the distinctive snare sound, it can compete with many beginners‘ wood cajon right away.

This is achieved by a sound-optimized cardboard with a continuous sound space and an ingenious construction with a real snare wire. The robust material allows a weight of up to 120 kg. It is easy to set it up and to fold it up again. When folded up, space-saving storage and transport of a larger number is possible.

The Carton Cajon is available in two sizes: Mini (height 37 cm) for children and teenagers and Standard (height 45 cm) for adults. This makes it ideal for group lessons, events or workshops and is therefore a favorable entry level cajon for beginners. Ideal for schools and kindergartens.

title: Sela SE001 Cajon Kit
desc:
With the Sela Snare Cajon Kit you can build your own professional Cajon in a very short time. This fun kit is perfect for craftspeople of all skills! Easy instructions, a simple manual and prefabricated parts make the assembly a breeze. After only three hours your Cajon will be ready to be played on.

The components included in the Sela Snare Cajon kit are often found only on very expensive Cajons. The playing area is stable, but thin enough to develop full musical potential. unlike other kits this Sela kit has a rich snare which can be adjusted or even fully removed according to your own musical taste. This opens up a wider range of sonic possibilities.

For those who have never played a Cajon this increasingly popular instrument can produce a wide range of sounds. Its deep bass and crisp snare sound are popular in a wide range of musical styles including Flamenco and World music or as a great rhythmic baking for any raw acoustic gig. This Cajon kit also includes a CD to help you get started with playing the Cajon.

The audio samples and backing tracks are perfect for practice and play along.

title: Roland EC10 El Cajon Hybrid Cajon
desc:
Roland EC10 El Cajon Hybrid Cajon The Roland EC 10 is a great new choice for your rig. Sick of relying on unpredictable mic solutions to bring out the full sound of your cajon onstage ? this could very well be the answer.

Completely self-contained with battery power and onboard amplification, the EC-10 EL Cajon is a unique and versatile hybrid that combines an authentic acoustic cajon with Roland’s electronic percussion technology. A Real Acoustic Cajon and Roland Sound Module in One Thanks to its compact size and versatility, the cajon has become the most popular instrument for on-the-go percussion, from local jams and street busking to nightclub performances and beyond.

With a built-in Roland sound module and independent head and edge sensors, the EC-10 extends the cajon’s range os uses. Spice up singer/songwriter and combo gigs with layered tambourine or djembe, add backbeats with an acoustic or TR-808 snare, or bring in some low-end thump with an electronic kick. Studio-optimized cajon sounds are also on hand to enhance the acoustic cajon voice for more depth, dimension, and punch.

Easy to Operate While Performing Focus more on your rhythm and less on the dials and settings.
